title: Season 3 — Vireze Arc (Midnight Treat)
premise: An epidemic of troubled civilians receive hypnotic powers as "treats" from a mysterious villainess called Midnight Treat. The city cannot decide whether the victims are villains or casualties, and the heroes tear themselves apart over how to stop the chaos. Midnight Treat is Vireze Tylow, an ancient vampiress who gives power away for the pleasure of watching what follows.
toneNotes: Halloween carnival noir. Mob panic, moral disagreement, and opportunistic costumes. The danger is distributed: a thousand ordinary people with one bad night and a new power.

goals: Keep the heroes fighting each other
Coordinate heroes and civilians against the treats

threats.name: Midnight Treat
threats.agenda: Gift hypnotic power to troubled civilians and let the resulting chaos expose how fragile the city's order really is.

threats.name: The Vigilante Purge
threats.agenda: Kill or imprison every treat-carrier before the law decides whether they are victims, and punish any hero who objects.
stages: Open war on the hero community

canonBeats.title: The First Treat
canonBeats.description: A civilian is gifted hypnotic power and causes a public, very visible incident.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The epidemic starts quietly; the first public incident happens later with a higher body count.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any ordinary person receiving and misusing a treat counts. The victim must be recognizable as a civilian, not a costumed villain.

canonBeats.title: The Vigilante Line
canonBeats.description: A vigilante kills or maims a treat-carrier, forcing the heroes and the police to take a public position.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The purge gains recruits and the heroes lose public trust.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The act can happen to an NPC or be interrupted. What matters is that the city sees the choice between protection and punishment.

canonBeats.title: The Heroes Fracture
canonBeats.description: A public disagreement between heroes over the treats becomes a lasting split, and Midnight Treat uses it.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The hero community coordinates too well; Midnight Treat escalates by targeting a beloved public figure instead.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any durable split over method, not just an argument. It may involve the Sirens, the police, or the Coalition.

canonBeats.title: The Siren's Plague
canonBeats.description: A public hero is treated and becomes a treat-themed villain, making the epidemic personal.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Another recognizable character becomes a treat instead; the epidemic advances a stage.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any treated-form rule may be used, or a new victim may be authored. Record the transformation source and keep the victim's original personality as a memory.

canonBeats.title: Unmask Midnight Treat
canonBeats.description: The heroes identify Vireze Tylow as Midnight Treat and corner her in her shuttered skyscraper.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Vireze disappears and the epidemic becomes self-sustaining; the final deadline advances.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The unmasking can happen through investigation, a treat's confession, or a direct ambush. Vireze may escape; the identity reveal is the function.

canonBeats.title: The Treat Ends
canonBeats.description: Vireze is captured, killed, or cleansed, and the gifted powers can be contained or reversed.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The final deadline passes: Midnight Treat's carnival becomes permanent, and the season ends in a recorded villain victory.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: A cure, a ritual, or a public renunciation all count. If Vireze is already gone, resolve through the fate of the epidemic instead and record the substitution.

threat.name: Midnight Treat Regime
threat.agenda: Hunt the resistance and make the victory permanent.

beats.title: Recruit the First Cell
beats.description: Gather survivors, defectors, and heroes into a functioning resistance cell.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The victor captures a prospective ally and the cell shrinks.
beats.rewriteHints: Any ally, defector, or contact may anchor the cell.

beats.title: Strike the Victor's Seat
beats.description: Hit the victor's headquarters and prove the regime is not invincible.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The regime tightens control and the resistance loses its base.
beats.rewriteHints: The target may be a symbol, a prison, or a supply hub.

threat.name: The Resistance
threat.agenda: Overthrow the victor and restore the old order.

beats.title: Break a Resistance Cell
beats.description: Locate and destroy a resistance cell before it can grow.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance recruits a named hero and gains influence.
beats.rewriteHints: Any cell, safehouse, or symbol of resistance counts.

beats.title: Conquer the Next District
beats.description: Take a neighbouring district and install an occupation government.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance holds the district and humiliates the victor.
beats.rewriteHints: Use an occupied district; the exact target may change.

conquest.goal: Conquer the neighbouring districts and city.
